nota.t: Scientific skills

Science process skills (observe, classify, measure, make inferences, predict, communicate, interpret data, control variables, hypothesize, experiment) and manipulative skills (use and operate apparatus properly, clean and store apparatus).
Nervous system
The nervous system consists of brain, spinal nerve and nerves. It controls all movements and actions of the body, and receives stimulation from the sense organs.
Puberty
In adolescence, the body undergoes changes: growing taller, voice changes and other changes. This is a sign of puberty; a Muslim is held accountable by Islamic law.
Getting enough sleep, a balanced diet and staying away from drugs keep our brains and nerves healthy.
Microorganisms
Life is very small and needs to be seen with a microscope. Examples: bacteria, viruses, fungi (yeast, molds), protozoa, algae.

baris: yeast for bread, bacteria for yogurt and tempeh, decomposers
diseases (flu, dengue through mosquitoes), stale food

t: Prevent infection: wash your hands, cover your mouth when you cough, vaccinate, cook food perfectly.

nota.t: Interaction

baris: trees compete for light and water

nota.t: Animals compete for food, water, space and mates. Plants compete for light, water, space and nutrients.
Extinction
Animals and plants can become extinct due to poaching, deforestation, pollution and natural disasters.

t: Conservation: national park, forest reserve, turtle conservation centre.
We: recycle, don't buy things from endangered animals, plant trees.

nota.t: Islam tells us to take care of nature because humans are caliphs on earth.
Power
Forces are repulsion or attraction. A force can change the shape, direction, speed and position of an object.
Friction is useful (slippery soles) but also destructive (tire wear). Reduce friction with lubricating oil, wheels, smooth surfaces.
Speed
Speed ​​= distance ÷ time. Units: m/s, km/h.
A car travels 180 km in 2 hours. Speed ​​= 180 ÷ 2 = 90 km/h.
An object that moves farther in the same time is faster.
Why does food spoil?
Food spoils due to the action of microorganisms. Signs: foul smelling, slimy, moldy, change in taste.
Preservation methods inhibit the growth of microorganisms.
Waste material
Practice 3R: Reduce (Reduce), Reuse (Reuse), Recycle (Recycle).
eclipse

baris: Sun – Earth – Moon (Earth in the middle)
Sun – Moon – Earth (Moon in the middle)

nota.t: Do not look at the solar eclipse with naked eyes. Use a special filter.
Muslims are circumcised to perform eclipse prayer (sunset for the Sun, eclipse for the Moon).
Galaxy
Galaxies are collections of billions of stars, gas and dust. Our Solar System is located in the Milky Way galaxy.

t: The Sun is one of the stars in the Milky Way.
Eight planets revolve around the Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
The Solar System is very small compared to the Milky Way.

nota.t: Allah spoke about the sky adorned with stars (Surah Al-Mulk, verse 5).
Stability
Stability is the ability of an object to remain or return to its original position. Objects are more stable if the base is wide and the centre of gravity is low (the bottom is heavier).
Strength
Strength is the ability to withstand a load without breaking. It depends on the type of material and the form of construction. The triangular shape makes the construction stronger.
Towers and bridges use triangular frames to be strong.
Technology
Technology is the use of science to create tools and ways to solve problems and make life easier.

baris: traditional medicine → X-ray machine → surgical robot

nota.t: Technology brings good, but also bad if misused (pollution, gadget addiction).
